project: Redline RL-MB-01 (nRF9151 tracker and black box)
status: Design with sourced parts. PCB not routed, nothing built or measured.

holdup.note: ASSUMPTIONS to measure: 1 firmware energy unit is taken as 0.5 J; the capacitor must also deliver the LTE-M burst current, which depends on its ESR.

components.name: Main board RL-MB-01
components.note: 4 layers advised for the RF paths; notches at the four lid screws; 4.8 mm hole for the tamper plunger

components.name: nRF9151 SiP: LTE-M, NB-IoT, NTN, DECT NR+, GNSS
components.note: Cortex-M33 for the application; one RF pin shared by the cellular, satellite and DECT NR+ modes

components.name: ADXL372 shock sensor, +-200 g
components.note: Instant-on 1.4 uA; peak capture; FIFO gives the pre-trigger waveform for the black box; SPI

components.name: ADXL367 motion sensor, +-2/4/8 g
components.note: Always on: wakes the system on movement (parked and armed) and tells moving from still when GNSS is jammed; I2C

components.name: nPM1300 PMIC: charger, fuel gauge, regulators
components.note: Charge 32 to 800 mA; two 200 mA bucks; I2C

components.name: 64 Mbit low-power flash: the black box memory
components.note: 8 MB, about 349,000 records of 24 bytes; 7 nA in deep power-down; SPI

components.name: GNSS filter then LNA
components.note: Filter before the LNA, as advised by Nordic for a passive antenna

components.name: Hold-up charger and ideal diode for C1
components.note: Charges C1 from VSYS; feeds VSYS from C1 when the supply drops; raises PWR_FAIL

components.name: Chip antenna 824-960 / 1710-2690 MHz
components.note: Cellular and DECT NR+ (1.9 GHz). Satellite NB-NTN uses L-band near 1.6 GHz, which is NOT covered: needs another antenna if that layer is enabled

components.name: GNSS patch antenna 18 mm
components.note: Faces the lid; non-metallic lid

components.name: USB-C receptacle (charge and black box readout)
components.note: VBUS, CC1, CC2, GND: charge only. The nRF9151 has no native USB, so there are no data lines

components.name: eSIM, soldered MFF2
components.note: Soldered: no card to pull out

components.name: Battery connector JST-PH 2, SMD
components.note: Locking, with a dot of glue

components.name: SWD pads Tag-Connect TC2030
components.note: No connector fitted: programming by pogo pins

components.name: Side button: arm, disarm, pair
components.note: Pressed through the -X wall

components.name: Status LED 0603
components.note: Sunk by the PMIC; invisible in stealth mode

components.name: Light pipe PMMA 3 mm
components.note: Through the lid above D1

components.name: Hold-up supercapacitor
components.note: 0.5 F assumed. Must be low enough in ESR for the modem burst: measure before choosing

components.name: Tamper switch (mounting)
components.note: Open while the device sits on its mount, closes when removed

components.name: Tamper plunger, 4 mm, spring loaded
components.note: Passes through the base and the board. Pressed by the mounting surface

components.name: Li-Po 1S 2000 mAh, protected
components.note: JST-PH 2 lead; protection circuit included; foam below. Air transport of lithium cells is regulated: to check

components.name: CC1 pull-down 5.1 kOhm
components.note: USB-C sink identification

components.name: CC2 pull-down 5.1 kOhm
components.note: USB-C sink identification

wires.note: The only cable inside the device. Check polarity before plugging.

firmware_notes: VDD_GPIO (V1V8) must rise more than 6 ms after VDD and ENABLE: sequence BUCK1 of the nPM1300.
I2C addresses of the ADXL367 and the nPM1300 are to be confirmed on their data sheets before routing.
nRF9151 GPIO assignment (CS0, CS1, INT1-3, BTN, TAMPER, PWRFAIL, COEX0) is fixed at routing.
Black box readout: no USB data on this board. Read the flash through the programming pads (SWD or a UART bridge on them) after recovery, or upload it over LTE-M when a link exists.
